securitytrails.name: SecurityTrails historical DNS
securitytrails.data_residency: Provider-controlled; confirm subscription agreement and jurisdictional suitability before approval.
securitytrails.attribution: Attribute historical DNS values to SecurityTrails and the provider's first/last-seen windows.
securitytrails.retention: Use case retention; review organization fields for incidental personal data.
securitytrails.cost: Subscription quota and auto-billing depend on the account plan; check before approval.
securitytrails.query_limits: Monthly quota and per-second rate limits apply; one record type/page per approved run.

hibp-account.name: Have I Been Pwned account breach search
hibp-account.data_residency: Provider-controlled; confirm contractual and jurisdictional suitability before approval.
hibp-account.attribution: Attribute breach names to HIBP; do not present a hit as proof that the account owner caused a breach.
hibp-account.retention: Use the case retention date; do not collect passwords or stealer logs.
hibp-account.cost: Subscription tier and RPM govern cost; confirm in the subscriber account.
hibp-account.query_limits: Account API is subscription-rate-limited; obey Retry-After and the approval max-runs cap.

hibp-domain.name: Have I Been Pwned verified-domain breach search
hibp-domain.data_residency: Provider-controlled; confirm contractual and jurisdictional suitability before approval.
hibp-domain.attribution: Attribute returned aliases and breach names to HIBP; verify relevance independently.
hibp-domain.retention: Use the case retention date; never export aliases in redacted derivatives by default.
hibp-domain.cost: Domain-search subscription tier depends on breach count and domain count; verify current terms.
hibp-domain.query_limits: Query infrequently; HIBP may throttle domain search. One verification and one search per run.

hunter-domain.name: Hunter domain search
hunter-domain.data_residency: Provider-controlled; confirm contractual and jurisdictional suitability before approval.
hunter-domain.attribution: Hunter-derived addresses are leads and must not be used for unsolicited contact.
hunter-domain.retention: Use the case retention date; exclude results from redacted derivatives by default.
hunter-domain.cost: Domain Search may consume credits according to plan; verify before approval.
hunter-domain.query_limits: Provider applies endpoint/key rate limits; this adapter makes one bounded domain-search call.

censys-host.name: Censys Platform v3 host lookup
censys-host.data_residency: Provider-controlled; confirm contractual and jurisdictional suitability before approval.
censys-host.attribution: Attribute host observations to Censys scan timestamps; do not treat them as a live scan.
censys-host.retention: Use case retention; review service banners for incidental personal data.
censys-host.cost: Platform API calls consume credits by account tier; confirm current balance.
censys-host.query_limits: Account concurrency/credit limits apply; this adapter uses one host lookup, no live rescan.

companies-house.name: UK Companies House company search
companies-house.data_residency: UK public-register service; review API and case jurisdiction before approval.
companies-house.attribution: Attribute company results to Companies House and retain the company number.
companies-house.retention: Use the case retention date; avoid unnecessary officer or address enrichment.
companies-house.cost: Public-data API access may be free; verify current API account terms.
companies-house.query_limits: Provider rate limits apply; this adapter makes one bounded search request.

shodan.name: Shodan host search (manual/approved future connector)
shodan.data_residency: Provider-controlled; review contractual and jurisdictional suitability.
shodan.attribution: Attribute indexed banners to Shodan and scan time, not current state.
shodan.retention: Use case retention; review banners for incidental personal data.
shodan.cost: Credits and available endpoints depend on the account tier.
shodan.query_limits: Provider/account limits apply; no in-tool network adapter is enabled.

maltego.name: Maltego graph import/export (manual)
maltego.data_residency: Local graph handling depends on selected desktop/cloud features; review before sharing.
maltego.attribution: Preserve source IDs and observed/inferred labels during manual import.
maltego.retention: Use case retention and delete secondary graph copies when required.
maltego.cost: License and data connector charges depend on plan.
maltego.query_limits: Manual export only; no Maltego Transform Hub calls from the toolbox.
